name: 3dxGC
description: Adaptive working-set governor for 3DXChat. Trims the game's resident footprint when it is backgrounded, minimised, or idle, or when its RAM use (or the PC's free RAM) crosses a set amount, and escalates to system-wide standby purges only under genuine memory pressure. Only the RAM-amount trigger may trim while the game holds focus, and it can be told not to.
author: 3DXModKit
